newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.23 pct lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.23 pct lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.23 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 446.79 points, down from 447.80 on Friday.
Total volume was 766,521 dinars against 701,951 dinars over the previous session.
Retail stores Monoprix fell 0.5 dinar to 31.5 dinars. Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF was down 0.36 dinar to 13.92 dinars.
Placement de Tunisie slid 0.24 dinar to 11 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels edged lower 0.17 dinar to 9.63 dinars.
